E-INVOICING MANDATE CHECKER · RUNS IN YOUR BROWSER · NOTHING UPLOADED

When must your business send and receive e-invoices?

Choose your country and size. You get your receive date, issue date, the required format, penalties, and whether your current invoicing method is enough.

A first read written from the published laws without a live lookup. Dates move; each result names the source to verify. It is not legal or tax advice.

Choose a country, then click Check my deadlines.

Result


    

    
 

  


  

    
What it does, and what it leaves to you

    
    
      
  • Covers: domestic B2B e-invoicing mandates in Germany, France, Belgium, Poland, Croatia, Greece, Italy and Spain, plus the EU ViDA date for intra-EU supplies.
    • 
      
  • Gives: receive date, issue date by size band, format, penalties and a nudge if paper or PDF is not enough.
    • 
      
  • Not decided: exemptions for specific transactions, B2C and B2G rules, your VAT group's treatment, whether your software is certified, and any date changed after this page was written.
    • 
    

    
After you pick a platform, validate real invoice files with the e-invoice preflight checker.

  


  

    
Common questions

    
Is e-invoicing mandatory for businesses in the EU?

    
Not EU-wide for domestic sales yet. Each Member State sets its own mandate and dates: Italy since 2019, Germany receiving from 2025 and issuing from 2027-2028, Belgium from January 2026, Poland from February-April 2026, France from September 2026-2027. The EU ViDA package makes it mandatory for intra-EU B2B supplies from 1 July 2030.

    
Is a PDF invoice an e-invoice?

    
No. Under these mandates an e-invoice is structured data (EN 16931 syntax such as UBL or CII, or a hybrid like Factur-X or ZUGFeRD), not a picture or a PDF of an invoice.

    
When must I start sending e-invoices in Germany?

    
Every business must be able to receive them since 1 January 2025. Issuing becomes mandatory on 1 January 2027 for businesses with prior-year turnover above EUR 800,000 and on 1 January 2028 for everyone else.

    
What do I need in France from September 2026?

    
Every business must be able to receive e-invoices through a certified platform from 1 September 2026. Large and mid-size companies must also issue them from that date, SMEs and micro-businesses from 1 September 2027.

    
Is my data uploaded anywhere?

    
No. Everything is calculated in your browser and nothing is sent; a test in the code asserts there are no network calls.

Your figures. This page runs in your browser and sends nothing anywhere; closing the tab discards them, and downloads are files on your own device.

    
Best-effort hosting, no SLA. These tools are free, experimental, and may be slow, broken, moved, or taken offline without notice. We do not promise uptime, backups of anything you type, or that a URL will keep working. Do not use this as a system of record: nothing you enter is saved anywhere.

    
Everything runs in your browser. Your answers are never uploaded; there are no accounts, cookies, or analytics vendors. Anonymous feature events (analysis_run, example_loaded, summary_downloaded) are counted only in local storage on your device, never with any of your data, and are switched off by Do Not Track.

    

    
Related tools: the e-invoice preflight checker, the EU VAT OSS calculator, the NIS2 scope checker and the Pay Transparency Directive checker.
